title: Yuva
desc: Eight youngsters, who are college friends, start focusing on their jobs once they graduate. However, they strive to balance their love lives and careers.

title: Ee Parakkum Thalika
desc: Unni, a bus owner, tries several ways to improve the condition of his bus, which is named after his late father. Things take a turn when the daughter of a powerful politician enters his life.

title: Pokkiri Raja
desc: Raja takes the blame for a murder committed by his father and is deserted by him. Years later, his father comes seeking his help when his younger brother, Surya, is falsely imprisoned.

title: Radhakrishna
desc: When the forest department takes away the elephant, the child is left without his dearest friend. The young boy undertakes a journey to find the lost animal.

title: Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi
desc: Arjun, a gangster, learns that a terrorist wants to take revenge from his mother, who is an IPS officer. In order to protect her, he strives to overcome all the odds.
